reason: I already snap my lunch board every morning, so if that one photo updates the site and posts the special on Google, it saves me a daily chore and 25 € is fine for that. I'd try it for a month and cancel if it slows me down.
objection: If the AI misreads my chalk handwriting and puts 4.50 instead of 14.50 on Google, customers will hold me to it, and in a lunch rush I might tap confirm without reading closely.
would_change_my_mind: If the first two weeks show it misreading prices from my board photos, so I end up retyping everything anyway, I cancel.
